title: Quirky Bouncy Argentinian Egg Rolls Spring Rolls
description: A festive Argentinian dish featuring egg rolls with a briny and bouncy twist, perfect for any occasion, and egg-free-friendly for all to enjoy.

ingredients.name: spring roll wrappers
ingredients.notes: found in the frozen food section

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the shredded cabbage, shredded carrots, and chopped scallions to the skillet and saute until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the sauteed mixture, salt, and black pepper.
Lay a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1/4 cup of the mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water and fold the bottom half up over the filling.
Fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Place the egg rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
